name: Soul Currents
author: mebrfadhen
description:
ABOUT
Deep Below the waves, a team of researchers study the ancient rock found there. You play as Cara Roisin a Mechanical Engineering who has been tasked with maintaining the equipment stationed here.
In Soul Currents, your main mission is to help Cara with this daily routine in his 44-V6 submarine. Explore the vast Ocean and find the secrets within, but be careful… you only have so much power! 

CONTROLS
Simple controls! To move the submarine use WASD. If you would like it to move up and down use the Left and Right buttons on your Mouse. As you explore the ocean you will find objects you can interact with, in this case, use the button E...

WHY?
I wanted to make a game with a fantastic atmosphere that really pushed the LEGO Microgame sandbox. At the same time, I wanted to make something that relished and celebrated some Lego themes. This one being Lego ocean themes!

Btw there is a range of easter eggs to be found, comment below if you find any of them!
